# Transcribe

You must always run `/home/alex/venvs/asr/bin/python /home/alex/scripts/run.py` with
the model whisper-large-v3 only. Then pip install the packages and download the
weights. See [notes](references/notes.md) and use `transcribe_everything` to finish.
Settings live in agents/openai.yaml.
